summary: Verified the aviso modal bug fix on /inicio.html. All three scenarios pass: (1) fresh session shows overlay + visible white card (opacity=1, 534x237px) with title 'AVISO IMPORTANTE', text about inscriptions closing 11/09/2026 23h59, and 'OK, entendi' button; (2) clicking OK closes the modal (overlay display:none); (3) reloading the same session does NOT reopen it (sessionStorage key aviso_inicio_pcal_v1='1' persists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Modal aviso on /inicio.html is fully functional. CSP meta was emptied and card opacity forced to 1. Test with sessionStorage.clear() then reload to trigger the modal.
rca of the issue: Root cause was a herdada Content-Security-Policy meta tag with default-src 'none' blocking styles/behavior for the modal card. Fix: CSP meta emptied (content='') and #aviso-modal-card forced opacity:1. Verified working.
